title: Write Scope Approval
description: Sole durable operator mutation grant for a frozen WriteScopeBody. Approval alone does not enable mutation execution; a later binding wave is required. Provenance is operator_asserted only — workers cannot mint approvals.

WriteScopeBody.description: Frozen normalized write-scope body copied from the approved proposal. reason is human rationale and non-authoritative for body_hash identity. Deny wins: any path matching both allowed_roots and denied_roots is denied at enforcement.

approval_id.description: Deterministic id: wsa- + sha256(proposal_id + ':' + approved_at + ':' + approved_by + ':' + expires_at + ':' + body_hash)[:24].

proposal_id.description: Parent WriteScopeProposal identity. Approvals require a durable proposal; prose cannot be approved.

run_id.description: Parent discovery run_id copied from the proposal for list filtering.

body_hash.description: Must equal the stored proposal body_hash at approve time. Fail closed on mismatch.

approved_by.description: Operator identity asserted at approve time (CLI --approved-by or equivalent). Never a worker identity.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the operator granted this approval.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry. TTL is mandatory; immortal approvals are rejected.

status.description: Lifecycle status. consumed is reserved for binding/mutation waves; Wave 2 defines the transition table and rejects impossible transitions. expired and revoked cannot become approved again.

approval_source.description: Surface that recorded the operator grant.

provenance.description: Only operator_asserted provenance is valid. Worker/self-approval claims are rejected.

revocation_id.description: Present when status is revoked; references the durable revocation record.
